payload.claim: The command-table comment for `saffron package` says "...whose own PACKAGE raised, or whose cell went green," dropping the distinguishing fact that the second case is specifically an `ORPHANED` task whose cell *raised* despite going green. Every other place this change touches keeps that qualifier: the `saffron/task.py` layout bullet two sections later says "a task whose PACKAGE raised, or whose cell raised but rebuilds green," README.md says "on an `ORPHANED` task whose cell went green," and `saffron/cli.py`'s `--help` text says "an ORPHANED one whose cell went green." Read on its own, line 65's "whose cell went green" reads as true of any ordinary `READY_FOR_REVIEW` task too, so the one line in CLAUDE.md an operator is most likely to skim understates what actually gates this new recovery path.
